# moddotplot-rs v0.3.0

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.3.0 hardens the scientific composition contract without changing schema-1 numeric
output. It remains a functional preview and is not a v1.0.0 release candidate.

## Scientific contract

Every built and frozen axis now owns its complete immutable scientific configuration
and a stable identity of its complete source base stream. Ordinary tile requests carry
coordinates and dimensions only. The tile kernel derives `k`, register count,
fingerprint width, estimator, and transform from the axes and rejects incompatible axes
before allocating output channels.

`FrozenAxis` storage is private behind read-only accessors and validated contiguous
joining. The fixed schema-1 tile fixture matches both retained v0.2.1 channel digests
exactly:

| Registers | FNV-1a digest of identity, direction, and support bytes |
| ---: | ---: |
| 256 | `6287528316830669084` |
| 1,024 | `15310234810913278692` |

## Production surface

Legacy b-bit estimator selection, fused register projection, and bounded sparse exact
correction are absent from the default public API. They remain available for historical
and scientific experiments only with the non-default Rust `validation` feature. Sparse
correction remains unavailable to the ordinary browser build.

Core matrix responsibilities are separated into axis validation, frozen provenance,
ordinary tile admission, and validation-only sparse policy modules. The Wasm boundary
now separates preparation, exact cache identity, resource admission, composition state,
and immutable session selection context.

## Compatibility

The browser UI and saved-input behavior are unchanged. This release intentionally
changes the Rust library API: callers construct geometric `TileRequest` values and read
frozen-axis data through accessors.

See the [validation record](v0.3.0/VALIDATION.md) for complete local evidence.
